dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.distractor_analysis_desc: Shows the frequency of incorrect options selected by students.
dashboard.distractor_analysis_benefit: Helps identify poor quality distractors or common student misconceptions.
dashboard.lo_attainment_desc: Average success rate across all defined Learning Outcomes.
dashboard.lo_attainment_benefit: Identifies which curriculum areas require pedagogical adjustments.
dashboard.pass_rate_desc: Percentage of students meeting the success threshold in assessments.
dashboard.pass_rate_benefit: Tracks institutional teaching effectiveness and student success trends.
dashboard.exam_quality_desc: Composite measure of exam difficulty and discrimination power.
dashboard.exam_quality_benefit: Ensures assessments are reliable and effectively distinguish student proficiency levels.
dashboard.bank_health_desc: Percentage of learning outcomes adequately covered by the question bank.
dashboard.bank_health_benefit: Ensures test validity by confirming all curriculum areas are properly assessed.
dashboard.performance_index_desc: A weighted composite of Academic, Operational, and Quality metrics.
dashboard.performance_index_benefit: Quickly assess the institutional pulse and identify systemic performance gaps.
dashboard.trend_benefit: Helps managers identify if institutional initiatives are yielding long-term improvements.
dashboard.pass_rate_trend_benefit: Enables long-term monitoring of assessment difficulty and student success.
dashboard.exam_quality_dist_desc: Plots exam difficulty against discrimination power.
dashboard.exam_quality_dist_benefit: Helps identify low-quality assessments that need review for better student differentiation.

executive.title: Executive Strategic Dashboard
executive.prep_hours_desc: Efficiency gain via AI-automated exam generation.
executive.prep_hours_benefit: Quantifies time saved for instructional staff to focus on teaching.
executive.accreditation_desc: Mapped LO mastery for ABET program compliance.
executive.accreditation_benefit: Provides quantitative evidence of curriculum mastery for external audits.
executive.intervention_desc: Improvement in at-risk student outcomes after coaching.
executive.intervention_benefit: Measures the impact of support programs on student retention.
executive.resource_allocation_desc: Identifies Learning Outcomes with low question bank coverage that require investment.

home.title: Welcome to TAMS Platform
home.subtitle: Please select a module to get started
home.dashboard_desc: Monitor student performance and learning outcomes.
home.corporate_desc: Analyze HR intelligence and organizational skill gaps.
home.executive_desc: High-level strategic insights and institutional reporting.

stats.tooltip_desc: Average, Median, and Standard Deviation help visualize the class performance spread.
stats.tooltip_benefit: Red dashed lines indicate the 1-SD range from the mean.

corporate.title: Corporate HR Dashboard
corporate.onboarding_desc: Time taken to integrate new hires.
corporate.skill_gap_desc: Delta between required and current competencies.
corporate.dept_perf_desc: Relative performance of each corporate department.
corporate.advancement_desc: Readiness for promotion or role expansion.
corporate.feedback_360_desc: Multi-perspective performance feedback from peers and managers.
corporate.feedback_360_benefit: Provides a comprehensive view of interpersonal and technical effectiveness.
corporate.dev_recommendations_desc: AI-suggested training based on current skill gaps.
corporate.dev_recommendations_benefit: Targets specific growth areas for rapid improvement.
corporate.heatmap_desc: Visualizes the proficiency levels across different roles and competencies.
corporate.heatmap_benefit: Helps identify talent gaps and strategically align development initiatives.

radar.title: Performance vs Targets
radar.desc: Visualizes actual institutional performance against pre-defined ideal targets.
radar.benefit: Helps identify systemic performance gaps and focus resource allocation.
